items.headline: What's next for Florida State after firing Mike Norvell
items.description: The Noles ousted Norvell in the midst of another down year. FSU must make a smart decision on what comes next.

items.headline: Missouri's Eli Drinkwitz: 'I'm not a candidate' for Florida State job
items.description: Missouri coach Eli Drinkwitz said in no uncertain terms Tuesday that he is "not a candidate" for the open Florida State job.

items.headline: Sources: FSU's top WR Duce Robinson (ACL) out for season
items.description: Duce Robinson, who leads Florida State in receiving yards and touchdowns, will miss the rest of the season with a torn ACL, sources told ESPN's Pete Thamel.
